🟣 Claude Code CLI (`claude`)

Use Anthropic's official Claude Code CLI powered directly by your Antigravity models (Gemini 3.7 Flash High / Claude Sonnet):

Windows PowerShell:
$env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080" $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "gravity-bridge" claude
Linux / macOS / Bash:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8080" export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="gravity-bridge" claude

🟢 Codex CLI / OpenAI Tools

$env:OPENAI_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1" $env:OPENAI_API_KEY = "gravity-bridge" codex

⚡ Aider CLI

aider --openai-api-base http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 --openai-api-key gravity-bridge --model openai/gemini-3.7-flash-high
